pages.en:
I won't save her.

If I go to her aid, certain death awaits me.

No living human being could choose otherwise.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I won’t help her.
There’s certain death waiting for me if I go help her.
If I’m human and if I’m alive, there’s nothing else I can do.

pages.en:
“Ah—aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”

My body refuses to stop, heedless of my heart.

—I cannot run away.

I know that if I go out there, I will die. But if I run now, I will survive only as a dead man…!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!”
My body does not stop.
I can’t run away.
I’ll die if I go out, but I’ll live the rest of my life as a corpse if I run away here…!
